answer: One identity binds one bonded distillery. The authority registers still, warehouse and key, then publishes a duty signal per batch; one licence backs one identity, duplicates rejected, weight after 90 days' duty-paid output. Each fake costs a 1,500-unit licence, a 2,000-unit still and harbor stock, plus 90 days — 3,500 units, three months, no shortcut. A hundred fakes: 350,000 units and 9,000 days. Cheapest cheat: buying a licensed mesa distillery for about 6,000 units — but the seller gives up the licence behind their own identity. A rented still fails inspection; forged papers fail.
